name: Tarangire National Park
tagline: Giant baobabs and Tanzania's largest elephant herds
intro: Tarangire is famous for its ancient baobab trees and large elephant herds. In the dry season thousands of animals gather along the river, making it superb for photography.
It is only two to three hours from Arusha, which makes it an ideal first stop or a standalone day trip.
bestTime: June to October, when wildlife concentrates along the Tarangire River.
metaTitle: Tarangire National Park Safari | Elephants & Baobabs | Glad Of Africa
metaDescription: Visit Tarangire for huge elephant herds and baobab landscapes, just 2-3 hours from Arusha. Day trips and multi-day northern circuit safaris.
